sloka: अवकाशो न सान्त्वस्य रक्षसेष्वभिगम्यते ।न दानस्य न भेदस्य नैव युद्धस्य दृश्यते ॥५-२-२९॥
transliteration: avakāśo na sāntvasya rakṣaseṣvabhigamyate ।na dānasya na bhedasya naiva yuddhasya dṛśyate ॥5-2-29॥

translations.english: 'There is no scope for reconciliation with the demons. It is not possible to win over them with gifts. They cannot be divided by dissension. There is no scope for war.
